nextHumanAction: In Chrome, stay on App Store Connect > Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API.
Click Request Access only if you approve enabling App Store Connect API access for the organization and agree to any Apple terms shown.
If Apple grants access and shows a key-management table, tell Codex: Authorized: create App Store Connect API key for EAS Submit and save it to 1Password.
If Apple shows legal terms, payment, organization, or account-holder confirmation, complete or report that gate before Codex proceeds.
Do not click Add for Review or submit the app for public App Review.
